correctness.rationale: The package's finite certificate is complete for the stated graph-metric scale. A fresh reconstruction of the 24-vertex truncated-cube graph gave 36 edges, cubic degree sequence, diameter 6, and exactly 1092 nonempty simplices in the third distance-power clique complex with f-vector (24,156,376,372,144,20). Replaying the printed vertex order produced 542 disjoint Morse pairs, exactly the listed critical vertex, one critical 2-simplex, and six critical 3-simplices; a full topological sort verified acyclicity, and an independent signed gradient reduction gave zero boundary coefficient from each critical 3-cell to the sole critical 2-cell. The Morse CW complex therefore has 2-skeleton S^2 and six degree-zero 3-cell attaching maps, hence the claimed wedge.
residual_risks: The result is only for the graph shortest-path metric at inclusive scale 3; it says nothing about Euclidean vertex distances or the full filtration.
